prompt: Create a high-contrast monochrome fashion photograph with silver halide film grain and zero color saturation. The scene is a surreal arctic night expedition on a steep snowbank, shot with a dramatic Dutch angle and a wide cinematic crop. A young woman with platinum blonde blunt bob hair, straight bangs, and two high side ponytails kneels beside an irregular black opening in the snow, as if peering into an ice cave or mirror-dark crevasse. She wears a bulky white futuristic snowsuit with puffed sleeves, a high collar, black zipper lines, harness straps, belt details, and small black square patches; her makeup is stark, with heavy lashes and black lipstick. Her gloved or bare hands press into the bright snow at the edge of the hole. Inside the dark opening, show one reflected or partially submerged duplicate figure in the same white outfit and twin ponytail hairstyle, distorted by shadow and the uneven rim of snow. Use harsh flash-like lighting so the white snow and suit blow out toward bright silver while the cave interior and left background fall into deep black. The background is an abstract snowy slope with no buildings or readable text. Emphasize gritty analog texture, sharp contrast, cold atmosphere, avant-garde editorial styling, and an unsettling sci-fi mood. No color, no watermark, no extra people beyond the main figure and the single reflected duplicate.

promptZh: 创作一张高对比度的黑白时尚摄影作品，呈现银盐胶片的颗粒感，且完全无色彩饱和度。场景设定在超现实的北极之夜，位于陡峭的雪坡上，采用戏剧性的荷兰式倾斜构图和宽银幕电影画幅。一位留着 铂金色 齐刘海波波头、扎着两个高侧马尾辫的年轻女性，跪在雪地中一个不规则的黑色裂口旁，仿佛正在凝视冰洞或如镜面般漆黑的裂隙。她身穿一件厚重的白色未来感雪地服，配有泡泡袖、高领、黑色拉链线条、安全带、腰带细节以及黑色小方块补丁；妆容冷峻，睫毛浓密，涂着 黑色唇膏。她戴着手套或裸露的双手按在洞口边缘明亮的雪地上。在黑暗的裂口内，展示一个倒影或半淹没的复制形象，穿着同样的白色服装，留着同样的双马尾发型，被阴影和不平整的雪缘所扭曲。使用类似强闪光灯的照明，使白雪和服装呈现出亮银色，而洞穴内部和左侧背景则陷入深邃的黑色。背景为抽象的雪坡，没有建筑物或可辨认的文字。强调粗犷的模拟质感、强烈的对比、寒冷的氛围、前卫的编辑风格以及令人不安的科幻情绪。无色彩，无水印，除主体人物及其单一倒影外，画面中不包含其他人物。
